notes: Offsets is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 OFFSETS once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. It has no owner, administrative controls, transfer fees or external mint or burn functions. No application contracts are included. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
